svg.aria-label: A treaty signed in 1950, amended once
svg.text: A treaty signed in 1950, amended once
Convention for the avoidance of double taxation on income
Mutual assistance in collecting taxes, and nothing else
Operative from this date; instruments exchanged that December
Seventy-six years, through every change in treaty practice
Article XIV(1) is the saving clause: each country may tax its own citizens as though the convention had not been made.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 8 September 2026
